notes: «قال إسحاق أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا أبو معاوية»: the verbs differ, the route is one; all three meet at أبو معاوية.
«مسلم» is a bare name in the text, not completed; the compiler is not written in the chain.
«- واللفظ لأبي كريب -» is an editor's gloss: left out. The Prophet's leaving for the mosque is scene.
